decisions.evidence: Putting the six comparisons together, the three inhibitor neighbors all become less compatible with the query because the query is smaller, less lipophilic, and less ring-rich, while the three non-inhibitor neighbors also support the same direction through the sulfonyl-bearing pattern, lower logP/logD, and generally less inhibitor-like size and ring features. The repeated signal across lipophilicity, molecular size, and aromatic/ring richness is more consistent with option (A): is not a PgP inhibitor.
